subject: Demo request — product recommendations (peak traffic & timeline)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interested in Redwood Inference — demo request

Hi Karthik,

We just completed a quick self-serve test of Redwood after the signup link, and it looks promising for a use case we have: real-time product recommendations at checkout. I wanted to see if we could schedule a short demo to understand fit and costs. A few upfront details to help you triage: 

- Use case: real-time recommendations + reranking at checkout across web + mobile.
- Current traffic: ~120k requests/day, average payload ~600 tokens.
- Peak concurrency: roughly 45 requests/sec during flash sales (peaks last ~30–90 minutes).
- Timeline: aim to start a small POC in ~6 weeks and pilot in Q4.

I've attached a small sampling of traffic (traffic-sample.csv) and a short note on our data residency constraints. Ops is cc'd for scheduling.

Can you share a few slots next week (PST) or point me to a calendar link?

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product — CartFlow
samir@cartflow.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Inference — demo request

Hi Samir — great to see you in the product, and thanks for the sample. I looped in Ben (SDR) and Monica (Solutions) so we can tailor the demo. A few quick qualification items so we make the 30-minute session high signal: 

1) Concurrency breakdown: is the 45 req/s mostly API calls originating from many browsers (many short-lived sessions) or from a smaller set of backend workers? Any estimate of tokens per call at peak (you noted avg 600 tokens — is that for both request+response or request only)?
2) Latency SLO: what p95/p99 are you targeting at checkout? Is 200ms p95 a hard requirement?
3) Model/behavior: are you planning to host your own model weights, use an open model via Redwood catalog, or evaluate Redwood-hosted models?
4) Security: do you need a VPC/private deployment for the pilot or is hosted ok for an initial POC?

Proposed 30-minute slots next week (all PST):
- Tue 8/5 10:00–10:30
- Wed 8/6 15:00–15:30
- Thu 8/7 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, share a couple windows and Ben will coordinate. I'm also attaching our pilot-readiness-checklist.pdf (short) so you can see typical data we ask for pre-pilot.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@cartflow.com
Date: 2025-08-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Inference — demo request

Thanks Karthik — quick answers below.

- Concurrency: it comes from our edge service; ~80% are short browser-originated requests; the rest are backend-batched hits from personalization jobs. At peak we see bursts to ~45 req/s but sustained for short windows.
- Tokens: ~600 tokens is request+response combined on average (request ~250 tokens / response ~350 tokens).
- Latency: we aim for p95 < 250ms in checkout, p99 ideally < 500ms — p95 is the critical metric.
- Model plan: initially evaluate a Redwood-hosted open model (fast inference variant), then consider dedicated deployment if economics and latency look good.
- Security: hosted POC is fine for now; we'll surface VPC needs if we move to pilot.

The Wed 8/6 15:00 PST slot works best for our product team and ops (ops asked to be on the call to validate log ingestion options). If you could send a calendar invite and a short agenda (30 min), we'll confirm.

Thanks — Samir
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@cartflow.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-05T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood Inference — demo request

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick details and confirming Wed 8/6 at 15:00 PST.

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m: Introductions & goals for POC
- 10m: Demo — runtime/latency profile + KV/prefix caching behavior for checkout flows
- 10m: Integration & pilot-readiness (logs, auth, data residency)
- 5m: Next steps (POC scope, success metrics, calendar of activities)

I've booked the slot and sent a Google Meet invite to your calendar (link included in the invite). Monica will lead the pilot scoping conversation — adding her so she can start a brief intake after the demo.

Attachments: pilot-readiness-checklist.pdf (internal checklist), traffic-sample.csv (from Samir)

Looking forward — Ben
